concerns.text: T021 implements Yeo atlas extraction, but the Plan and Constitution mandate AAL atlas (Principle VI). T021 must be re-ordered/re-written to implement AAL extraction (PCC, mPFC, IPL, angular gyrus) BEFORE any US2 tasks (T022+) that consume these ROIs. Currently, the foundational artifact (atlas) is semantically misaligned with the consumer tasks.

T015 (Motion Filter) is unchecked/missing, yet T022 (Time Series Extraction) explicitly lists 'Dependency: Requires T015'. This creates a broken producer-consumer chain: the consumer (T022) cannot execute because its required producer (T015) is not scheduled. T015 must be moved to Phase 2 or marked as a hard prerequisite before T022.

T013 (fMRIPrep Docker runner) and T016 (Nilearn fallback) are unchecked/missing, yet T014 (Motion extraction) and T022 (Time series) depend on their outputs (preprocessed BOLD/motion params). The pipeline has a critical gap: the data producer (preprocessing) is missing, blocking all downstream analysis tasks.

T012a (Metadata Schema) and T012b (Design Verification) are unchecked/missing, but T018 (Dataset-variable fit verification) depends on them. T018 cannot function without the schema and logic defined in T012a/b. These foundational tasks must precede T018.

T034 (Meta-analysis) depends on T027/T032 (Effect Sizes) from US2. While the dependency is noted, T027 and T032 are unchecked/missing. The consumer (T034) is scheduled before its producers (T027/T032) are guaranteed to exist. Ensure T027/T032 are marked as completed or moved to Phase 3/4 start.

T021 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) but is the sole producer of the DMN ROI masks required by T022. If T022 is started in parallel with T021, it will fail. The [P] tag on T021 is misleading if it implies it can run in parallel with *any* US2 task; it must strictly precede T022.
